messages:
maria (SRE): Heads-up, our `model-decode-error` monitor has been noisy since ~02:00 UTC. Fires ~every 8-12m. Looks correlated with the nightly backfill job. Can someone either tune the alert or add a mute window?
observability-bot: Monitor `model-decode-error` triggered 16 times in the last 6h. See dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/alerts/model-decode-error
devon (ML infra): I can take a look. Most of these are coming from requests with `source=backfill`. We should either filter those out or change the threshold.
maria (SRE): Agree — we don't want the oncall woken for expected degradation during backfills.
sam (eng-runtime): Suggestion: update monitor to exclude `source="backfill"` AND switch to rate-based check (errors / total requests) to avoid spiky absolute counts. Example query:```promql
(sum(increase(inference_decode_errors_total{source!="backfill"}[5m]))
/ sum(increase(inference_requests_total{source!="backfill"}[5m]))) > 0.01
```This keeps sensitivity but ignores backfills.
devon (ML infra): That looks good. Another option is a mute window 01:30-03:30 UTC weekdays while backfill runs — faster to roll out. I can add the mute and then change the monitor later.
maria (SRE): Fastest path is fine. Do the mute + create a follow-up ticket to harden the monitor.
devon (ML infra): Done — created INF-456 and added a scheduled mute for 01:30-03:30 UTC weekdays. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-456. I also added a note in the monitor: "exclude backfill in next PR".
sam (eng-runtime): Can you paste the exact monitor edit you made so I can review?
devon (ML infra): I used the Datadog monitor edit: query -> filter by `source:!backfill`, threshold unchanged for now (0.02). Also added a suppression rule when tag `job=backfill` is present.
maria (SRE): Thanks — can you also add the dashboard panel link to the ticket so we can check future regressions?
devon (ML infra): Yep added panel: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/alerts/model-decode-error?panelId=3 to INF-456.
maria (SRE): Perfect. Leaving this thread open until we see whether noise stops after the mute. :thumbsup:
observability-bot: Mute scheduled by devon for `model-decode-error`: weekdays 01:30-03:30 UTC (recurring).
maria (SRE): Thanks everyone — will close INF-456 after a week of quiet.
